official_base.note: This is the official Qwen Transformers-format base source. A later metadata/card state may exist; the immutable source revision is retained as a reproducible provenance anchor rather than claimed as current main.

selected_local_gguf_baseline.upstream_usage_claim: repository documents direct llama.cpp llama-server/llama-cli use

llama_cpp.risk_note: Historical/current issue reports show Qwen3.5 backend/conversion edge cases on some derived models/backends. Therefore repository documentation is not promoted to clay-direct-dev runtime evidence.

hypothesis: A Q4_K_M community quantization faithful to the official Qwen3.5-4B base can provide a reproducible local dialogue baseline with materially lower resident footprint than full-precision weights while preserving sufficient German conversational behavior for the Trigger-7 Pareto frontier.
counterhypothesis: The Q4_K_M quantization and/or llama.cpp path materially degrades German dialogue, tool/state adherence, TTFT, or long-turn stability, making another quant/runtime or a smaller interaction model superior despite nominal compatibility.
falsifier: Run exact-SHA quarantine download and exact-runtime benchmark on clay-direct-dev with identical German VoiceSessionCapsule corpus; record load success, model identity, TTFT, time-to-first-speakable-clause, tokens/s, RSS/VRAM, interruption behavior, dialogue quality and no hidden outbound model inference.
